portfolio.title: Store API (ASP.NET Core Web API)
portfolio.description: Production-grade RESTful API built with ASP.NET Core 8, C#, and Entity Framework Core with Code-First Migrations, SQLite, JWT authentication, and role-based authorization.
highlights: Repository & Unit-of-Work design pattern for testable, decoupled data access
Role-Based Authorization (User vs Admin) with secure JWT bearer authentication
Optimized EF Core query pipelines with AsNoTracking() and indexed search filters
Interactive Swagger / OpenAPI documentation for seamless client integration

portfolio.title: Mappi (Flutter Mapping & Navigation)
portfolio.description: Production-grade Flutter mapping and navigation app with multi-layer vector tiles, high-performance POI search, offline tile cache, and heads-up display (HUD) driving navigation.
highlights: Vector tile caching engine enabling fast offline route and terrain rendering
Real-time geographic point-of-interest indexing and proximity calculation algorithms
Adaptive heads-up display (HUD) night-mode for low-distraction driving navigation
State management architecture built on reactive streams and Clean Architecture

portfolio.title: Chittago (Offline Chattogram Navigation)
portfolio.description: Complete open-source offline-ready map and navigation app for Chattogram Division, Bangladesh, packaged with local spatial layers and essential community POI databases.
highlights: Native Android architecture utilizing Kotlin coroutines and Android Jetpack
Pre-packaged MBTiles database providing instant search without cellular connection
Curated localized POI layers covering regional healthcare, emergency hubs, and transit
Low-memory raster tile rendering engine tuned for budget Android devices

portfolio.title: RedGrid (Emergency Blood Donor Network)
portfolio.description: Real-time emergency blood bank and donor dispatch application connecting hospital requests with available registered donors across geographic proximity clusters.
highlights: Urgent blood dispatch notification engine with geolocation proximity filtering
Donor eligibility countdown tracker based on 90-day medical donation intervals
Strict verification workflows safeguarding donor privacy and emergency contact details
Cross-platform client designed for rapid one-tap emergency request broadcasting

portfolio.title: Doctor Dekhao (Telemedicine Platform)
portfolio.description: Led backend engineering for a 4-member team. Architected and deployed high-concurrency RESTful APIs serving patient-doctor video consultations under strict real-time constraints.
highlights: Designed relational database schemas with zero-downtime migrations in MySQL
Engineered real-time consultation booking and doctor schedule sync algorithms
Integrated secure payment gateways and SMS notification microservices
Managed AWS infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3) with Dockerized deployment pipelines

portfolio.title: Hamd-Shop E-Commerce System
portfolio.description: Full-featured online commerce system built with Laravel and MySQL, featuring catalog search, inventory tracking, payment processing, and administrative dashboards.
highlights: Relational inventory control with ACID transactional consistency during order checkout
Dynamic category filtering, keyword search, and customer account workflows
Admin panel for product management, coupon code logic, and sales metrics

portfolio.title: SaaS AI (AI Model Platform)
portfolio.description: All-in-one multi-tenant AI service orchestration platform providing a diverse range of AI model services with streaming responses and metered token billing.
highlights: Streaming response pipeline utilizing Next.js Edge runtime for sub-second latency
Stripe subscription webhooks and metered API usage tracking per organization
Prisma ORM schema modeling with MongoDB persistence and strong typing

portfolio.title: Bookish (Bookstore API Platform)
portfolio.description: Minimalistic, high-throughput bookstore catalog and search API with typed domain models, cursor-based pagination, and schema validation.
highlights: Cursor-based pagination engine minimizing database query overhead on large datasets
Declarative request validation and sanitized query response filters
Clean Architecture layers decoupling domain entities from HTTP transport
